主要内容: Nordic American Tankers Limited (NYSE:NAT) announced on March 20, 2013, that it has entered into a preliminary agreement to acquire its twenty-first vessel, a very modern double-hull Suezmax tanker delivered from a top yard in South Korea earlier this year. The agreed purchase price is in the region of $55 million. This first-class vessel is expected to be delivered to the company no later than May 15, 2013. The acquisition will be financed from the financial resources of the company. The vessel was built at high technical specifications. The company's focus is on expanding its fleet and maintaining its competitive position in the maritime transportation industry. The press release highlights NAT's commitment to safety for crew, vessels, and the environment, emphasizing its quality-driven approach. The company is pursuing expansion to increase its dividend and earnings capacity. NAT's strong balance sheet and transparent operating model are cited as key factors in its competitive position. The document includes a cautionary statement regarding forward-looking statements, noting that these are subject to significant uncertainties and contingencies. Factors such as global economic conditions, market fluctuations, and regulatory changes are identified as potential risks that could affect the company's performance. The release underscores the importance of maintaining a solid financial foundation and adapting to market dynamics to sustain growth and profitability.
